regions.label: Right ACC
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right ACC, which is where it was aimed.

regions.label: Right OFC
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right OFC, which is where it was aimed.

regions.label: Right parietal association cortex (aimed at Right DHC)
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right parietal association cortex, not Right DHC. The signal is real; the label is not the one on the map, and it is drawn under its own name. A circuit leaves relocated probes out entirely, so this region is grey even though Coupling computes it.

regions.label: Right POR
regions.why: Histology says this probe is not in Right POR, and does not say where it is instead. There is no region label that could honestly go on these channels, so nothing is computed from them.
